message: Command `cat /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/lwan/fuzz/README; echo "=== dict ==="; cat /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/lwan/fuzz/request_fuzzer.dict` executed with exit code 0.

message.content:
These crash files are for the request_fuzzer, not necessarily the proxy protocol. Let me look at the fuzz harness to understand how the input is fed and whether proxy protocol is enabled.

Let me look at the fuzz directory README and the fuzzer source.

content:
This directory contains files that managed to crash something in Lwan
after being fuzzed.  They have been committed alongside the fix, so
it's easier to find them with git blame.

`http.dict' has been copied from the h2o web server project:
https://github.com/h2o/h2o/blob/c14554e7/fuzz/http.dict
